auth.login_intro: Enter the email and password your company gave you.
auth.help: Trouble signing in? Contact your company's HR department.
auth.forgot_intro: Enter your email. If it belongs to an active account, we will send you a link to create a new password.
auth.forgot_sent: If the email belongs to an active account, we will send a link to reset the password. Check your inbox.
auth.reset_intro: The password must have at least 12 characters, with letters and numbers.
auth.reset_done: Your password was changed. You can sign in now.
auth.reset_missing_token: The link is incomplete. Request a new one.
auth.generic_error: The operation could not be completed. Try again.
auth.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
auth.tenant_suspended: The organization is suspended. Contact the administrator.
auth.missing_tenant: Sign in from your organization's address (for example, yourcompany.aynihr.pe).
